thread:
Ravi K: FYI - noticed a drift in entitlement counts for AcmeEdge customers starting 2025-02-10 00:00 UTC. looks like ~2% of accounts got a negative delta after daily roll.

Tess M: oof. is this the same timezone-cutover thing we saw last year?

Lina (partner-eng): not the same. partner switched their collector to use local-minute batching and committed to a daily flush at 00:00 local. when our aggregator applied UTC rollups some hour-boundaries overlapped.

Billing Bot: pipeline alert: daily-rollup-job failed 02:01 UTC for shard 7 with "negative-usage-detected".

Ravi K: can someone dump 5 sample records (before/after) for an affected account? need to see event ids and timestamps.

Tess M: pasted samples below (redacted):
```json
{"account_id":"acct_99","event_id":"e_20250210_001","sku":"ACME-DEVICE-CORE","units":100,"received_at":"2025-02-09T23:59:50-05:00","ingest_ts":"2025-02-10T04:59:50Z"}
{"account_id":"acct_99","event_id":"e_20250210_001","sku":"ACME-DEVICE-CORE","units":100,"received_at":"2025-02-10T00:00:10-05:00","ingest_ts":"2025-02-10T05:00:10Z"}
```

Lina (partner-eng): those are duplicate-ish because the collector emits on flush + immediate retry on net timeout. their event IDs are same, no seqno.

ops-oncall: looking. our ingestion dedupe currently keys on partner_event_id only, but downstream rollup uses (account_id, day, sku) and sums by timestamp bucket; ordering ended up subtracting earlier bucket when later duplicate arrived marked as "correction".

Ravi K: that's the root cause. plan: immediate short-term rollback + long-term contract + integration changes. propose steps:
1) stop daily-rollup-job shard 7 (prevent further incorrect deltas)
2) run de-dupe on raw_ingest for 2025-02-09T22:00:00Z..2025-02-10T06:00:00Z using (partner_id,event_id,sku) exact matches
3) recompute per-account day totals and generate reconciliation deltas (store in billing_reconciliations table)
4) apply compensation credits for accounts with negative delta after review (customer-success to approve > $X)
5) require partner to include seqno header or idempotency_id on retries and switch to backoff policy
6) add guard in rollup to drop corrections that would create negative totals unless flagged by ops

Tess M: I can run de-dupe and recompute step 2+3 now. estimate: de-dupe 20m, recompute 45m per shard.

Lina (partner-eng): partner will emit a one-off trimmed replay file with idempotency_id=acme_edge_replay_20250210 and a seqno field. we'll also deploy a small change to collector to stop immediate double-send on timeout.

Billing Bot: ledger-sync blocked for shard 7 until reconciliation marker cleared.

Ravi K: who owns customer outreach?

Lina (partner-eng): partner-eng and customer-success. we'll draft a short email template.

ops-oncall: started de-dupe job on shard 7 (query: delete from raw_ingest where duplicate key in subquery). logging progress to /runs/replay-1749994444.log

Tess M: de-dupe completed. recompute job 1/4 done. found 82 accounts with non-zero deltas, top 5 account deltas attached in the run log.

Ravi K: nice. please hold off auto-credits until CS ok's manual review for those with delta > $200. for micro-deltas we can auto-apply.

Lina (partner-eng): replay posted to /metering/replay with idempotency_id header; partner confirmed exponential backoff enabled.

Billing Bot: replay endpoint accepted file, returned HTTP 200, created reconciliation batch id rec_20250210_01.

Ravi K: thanks team. I'll update the marketplace integration doc with a clear requirement: every partner emit stable event_id + optional seqno, and use idempotency header for replays. I'll also add a runbook entry to fail rollups if negative totals would be produced.

Lina (partner-eng): thanks all. we'll follow up with a contract change proposal. :handshake:

ops-oncall: marking shard 7 as cleared at 2025-02-10T10:10:00Z in the incident tracker.
